programme.title: Los últimos rinocerontes
programme.desc: La fotógrafa Ami Vitale acompaña a un equipo de científicos mientras intentan salvar al rinoceronte blanco del norte de la extinción. Con solo dos hembras restantes en el planeta, el equipo corre contra el tiempo para lograr un hito revolucionario: el primer embarazo de rinoceronte por sustitución en el mundo. A medida que el tiempo se agota, la supervivencia de esta especie emblemática depende de los esfuerzos incansables de cuidadores, guardabosques e investigadores.

programme.title: Los elefantes fantasma de Angola
programme.desc: Cuenta la leyenda que en las tierras altas de Angola se esconden «elefantes fantasma» que nunca han sido vistos por los seres humanos. El aclamado director Werner Herzog («Grizzly Man») sigue una épica expedición a las tierras altas de Angola liderada por el explorador de National Geographic y biólogo conservacionista Dr. Steve Boyes para encontrar estas majestuosas y esquivas criaturas.

programme.title: Wild India: Nilgiris
programme.desc: Durante más de dos mil quinientos millones de años, las fuerzas de la naturaleza han moldeado minuciosamente las Montañas Nilgiri hasta convertirlas en el lugar mágico que son hoy, ayudando a que se convirtieran en la primera Reserva de la Biosfera de la UNESCO en la India. Emprende un viaje para descubrir estas "montañas azules", una tierra que ha desafiado las nociones convencionales de lo que es la vida salvaje y que ha demostrado la extraordinaria capacidad de la naturaleza para adaptarse y prosperar en medio de la presencia humana. Aquí habita una historia de esperanza, fragilidad y futuros interconectados, donde humanos y fauna comparten los límites difusos de una naturaleza común.

programme.title: Los secretos de las abejas
programme.desc: El explorador de National Geographic, Bertie Gregory, se adentra en las vidas extraordinarias de las abejas, unos de los animales más importantes del planeta. A lo largo de tres años, cámaras especiales ofrecieron una rara ventana al interior de una sola colmena, revelando su mundo oculto. Pero con más de 20.000 especies de abejas que polinizan un tercio de los alimentos del mundo, esta serie descubre su asombrosa arquitectura e inteligencia, desvelando sus secretos.

programme.title: Los secretos de las abejas
programme.desc: El explorador de National Geographic Bertie Gregory vuelve al mundo de las abejas melíferas mientras trabajan contrarreloj para reconstruir su colonia antes del invierno. En el planeta, otras especies enfrentan sus propios desafíos: desde las abejas de Dawson que luchan por conseguir pareja, hasta las abejas melíferas afectadas por la expansión global del ácaro varroa. Junto al Dr. Sammy Ramsey, Bertie investiga las crecientes presiones que amenazan a las abejas y las soluciones innovadoras para asegurar su futuro.

programme.title: La increíble granja del Dr. Pol
programme.desc: El Doctor Pol, Charles y Ben inician el agotador proceso de enfardar heno y además, los Pol traen a otro animal a la granja: un emú.

programme.title: El increíble doctor Pol
programme.desc: Desde un parto desgarrador a un parto de emergencia, ¡los veterinarios obran milagros! No hay pausa mientras la Dra. Brenda y la Dra. Lisa tratan varias lesiones en los pies, incluido un Sheltie con los dedos rotos. El Dr. Pol examina un enorme mastín con problemas estomacales y un conejo herido. La familia Pol agrega una yegua frisona preñada a la manada y la Dra. Nicole tiene las manos ocupadas con un gallo y un gato.

programme.title: El increíble doctor Pol
programme.desc: ¡Desde lo peculiar a lo asombroso, Pol Vets lo ve todo! El ojo herido de un gato esconde una sorpresa, un extraño pato tiene problemas para poner huevos, un dócil burro sufre una llaga en la pezuña y una preciada cabra se rompe una pata. El Dr. Pol comienza bien el día con 26 controles de salud de cachorros, la Dra. Lisa resuelve un caso de falta de cola y la Dra. Nicole va a cazar comida.

programme.title: Cazadores del arrecife
programme.desc: Los arrecifes de coral tropicales son la viva imagen de una tranquilidad llena de color y luz, pero ésa es la perspectiva de un submarinista. Para los habitantes con escamas y branquias, se trata de un entorno en el que los peces se comen a los peces, gobernado por manadas de delfines que merodean por la zona a la hora de comer mientras todos los demás corren a esconderse. Armas increíbles, camuflaje, defensas venenosas y estrategias excepcionales han evolucionado entre los pequeños cazadores en constante competición. El pez león caza en manada, inyectando veneno en las púas de los peces que se oponen. El camarón mantis tiene visión polarizada y es el más rápido del planeta. Las sepias transforman su piel para adaptarla a la arena y atacan con arpones tentaculares. La caza comienza en las mareas cambiantes.

programme.title: Mayday: catástrofes aéreas
programme.desc: El día 24 de mayo de 1988, el vuelo 110 de Taca Airlines, un Boeing 737, atraviesa una fuerte tormenta mientras empieza el descenso hacia Nueva Orleáns. En ese momento los dos motores se paran y el avión empieza a caer. Los treinta y ocho pasajeros se preparan ya para lo peor, pero los pilotos consiguen completar uno de los aterrizajes más impresionantes de la historia de la aviación comercial. A partir de ahí, correspondió a los investigadores averiguar por qué los motores de un Boeing 737 casi nuevo fallaron en pleno vuelo.

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas
programme.desc: En plena epidemia de COVID-19, el vuelo 1344 de Air India Express repatría a ciudadanos indios desde Dubái y se encuentra en la aproximación final al aeropuerto de Calicut en medio de fuertes lluvias, visibilidad reducida y vientos fuertes. La traicionera pista de aterrizaje no deja margen para el error. Tras un primer intento fallido, el Boeing 737-800 toma tierra, pero no consigue detenerse y se precipita por un barranco. El avión se rompe con el impacto, causando la muerte de 21 personas, incluidos los dos pilotos. Al principio, los investigadores sospechan que se trata de un problema con el sistema de frenado. Pero pronto descubren un fallo impactante de naturaleza completamente diferente. Por alguna razón, el avión entró por encima de la senda de planeo, sobrepasó la zona de aterrizaje y se salió de la pista. Y la causa fatal queda registrada en la grabación de voz de la cabina.

programme.title: El misterio del diluvio universal
programme.desc: ¿Cómo era en realidad el mundo descrito en el Génesis? Los nuevos hallazgos desvelan los extraordinarios logros de la civilización sumeria hace 6.000 años y muestran el modo en que su legado influyó posteriormente a los escritores de la Biblia. ¿Por qué el sur de Irak ejerció un papel clave en el Antiguo Testamento? y ¿realmente el colapso de la sociedad sumeria influyó en una de las más grandes historias jamás contadas (la de Noé y el Diluvio Universal)?

programme.title: Los secretos de Nínive y Babilonia
programme.desc: Nínive y Babilonia eran dos superpotencias del Mundo Antiguo, pero para los escritores de la Biblia eran ciudades de pecado. En Nínive, los arqueólogos están uniendo las piezas de las maravillas perdidas destruidas por el Estado Islámico. En Babilonia, los especialistas restauran la Puerta de Ishtar, construida por un infame tirano bíblico. ¿Por qué se describen de una forma tan negativa estos lugares en el Antiguo Testamento? y ¿cómo eran en realidad esas ciudades?

programme.title: De polo a polo con Will Smith
programme.desc: En el Polo Sur, donde las temperaturas pueden descender de los -73 °C, Will se expone a vientos gélidos. Esquía, camina y escala por gigantescos campos de hielo y acantilados con la ayuda de uno de los mejores atletas polares del mundo, Richard Parks. En una de las estaciones de investigación más aisladas del planeta, los científicos toman muestras de hielo a gran profundidad y hacen sacrificios increíbles para llevar a cabo sus investigaciones.

programme.title: De polo a polo con Will Smith
programme.desc: Will, al que toda la vida le han aterrado las arañas, se adentra en la Amazonia ecuatoriana en busca de criaturas mortales. Junto al profesor Bryan Fry y la montañera local Carla Perez, se adentran 60 metros en una red de cuevas conocida como «el útero de la Tierra» para descubrir la tarántula gigante. Con técnicas de vanguardia, le extraen el veneno, que podría ser crucial para salvar millones de vidas.

programme.title: De polo a polo con Will Smith
programme.desc: Will, Bryan y Carla acompañan al anciano waorani local, Penti Baihua, en el Amazonas, en busca de la serpiente más grande del mundo: la anaconda verde gigante. Con cuidado, le quitan una escama de la piel a la serpiente de 5 metros. Will pasa del temor al alivio y luego a la alegría. Esa escama puede presentar la salud de todo el ecosistema, algo crucial para el futuro de la fauna y de los waorani.

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas
programme.desc: En plena epidemia de COVID-19, el vuelo 1344 de Air India Express repatría a ciudadanos indios desde Dubái y se encuentra en la aproximación final al aeropuerto de Calicut en medio de fuertes lluvias, visibilidad reducida y vientos fuertes. La traicionera pista de aterrizaje no deja margen para el error. Tras un primer intento fallido, el Boeing 737-800 toma tierra, pero no consigue detenerse y se precipita por un barranco. El avión se rompe con el impacto, causando la muerte de 21 personas, incluidos los dos pilotos. Al principio, los investigadores sospechan que se trata de un problema con el sistema de frenado. Pero pronto descubren un fallo impactante de naturaleza completamente diferente. Por alguna razón, el avión entró por encima de la senda de planeo, sobrepasó la zona de aterrizaje y se salió de la pista. Y la causa fatal queda registrada en la grabación de voz de la cabina.

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas
programme.desc: El vuelo 6316 de Korean Air se dirige a Seúl con una carga no peligrosa. Pero poco después del despegue, los pilotos tienen dificultades para navegar por los cielos de Shanghái. El controlador se da cuenta de que el avión no está ascendiendo a la altitud asignada. En cuestión de minutos, el MD-11F desaparece por completo del radar y se estrella contra un barrio residencial. El enorme impacto registra el equivalente a un terremoto de magnitud 1,6, destruye la caja negra y se cobra la vida de cinco civiles y los tres tripulantes. Investigadores de China, Corea del Sur y Estados Unidos unen sus fuerzas y pronto descartan tanto problemas mecánicos como sabotaje. Solo cuando reconstruyen el vuelo en un simulador, el misterio comienza a desvelarse y llegan a una sorprendente conclusión. Traducción realizada con la versión gratuita del traductor DeepL.com.

programme.title: Especial Europa: maravillas de la ingeniería
programme.desc: Alcanza nuevas cotas con este emocionante análisis de la audaz ambición y los retos técnicos que se esconden tras las estructuras más altas e innovadoras de Europa. Desde la Sagrada Familia de Barcelona, a punto de completarse tras más de 140 años, hasta los rascacielos modulares que están remodelando el horizonte del Reino Unido y las revolucionarias torres energéticamente neutras de Ámsterdam, este episodio revela la ingeniería de precisión y los materiales avanzados que permiten a estos edificios alcanzar récords. Los conservadores de Polonia escalan la torre de madera más alta del continente para preservar un pedazo de historia, mientras que equipos de los países nórdicos y Alemania abren nuevos caminos con primicias arquitectónicas. Las entrevistas con expertos y responsables de las obras ofrecen una visión detallada de cómo la visión y la experiencia se entrecruzan para redefinir lo que es posible en la construcción vertical en toda Europa.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: Año 2077. Hace más de 60 años, unos extraterrestres destruyeron la Luna, provocando la devastación de la Tierra. Aunque los alienígenas fueron derrotados, el planeta quedó prácticamente inhabitable y todos los humanos fueron evacuados a Titán, una de las lunas de Saturno. En la actualidad, sólo dos personas habitan la Tierra: Jack Harper, encargado de reparar los drones que la humanidad utiliza para extraer los recursos hídricos del planeta, y su compañera Victoria Olsen, responsable de las comunicaciones con la colonia humana.Segundo filme como director -tras "Tron: Legacy"- del estadounidense Joseph Kosinski, una película de ciencia ficción ambientada en una Tierra postapocalíptica de un futuro cercano. Basada en una novela gráfica del propio Kosinski, está protagonizada por Tom Cruise, Morgan Freeman, Olga Kurylenko, Andrea Riseborough y Nikolaj Coster-Waldau.

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Por razones desconocidas, el núcleo interior de la Tierra ha dejado de rotar, provocando el rápido deterioro del campo electromagnético del planeta. De forma instantánea, comienza a cambiar la vida en el globo. En Boston, mueren de forma súbita 32 personas con marcapasos, en San Francisco se hunde el puente del Golden Gate, en la londinense Trafalgar Square bandadas enteras de palomas pierden el control y vuelan poseídas por el pánico y en Roma los muros del Coliseo se desploman. Para buscar una solución a esta crisis, las autoridades piden ayuda al geofísico doctor Josh Keyes y a un grupo de los mejores científicos mundiales. Deberán viajar al centro de la Tierra en un vehículo subterráneo, al mando de la mayor Rebecca 'Beck' Childs y del comandante Robert Iverson. Su misión es detonar un dispositivo nuclear que sirva para reactivar el núcleo y salvar al planeta de una destrucción segura.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Un cohete de la Fundación Vida se estrella en Malasia, perdiendo uno de los organismos que transportaba. En San Francisco, el incisivo periodista Eddie Brock se ve obligado a entrevistar a Carlton Drake, el excéntrico dueño de Fundación Vida.'Spin-off' de "Spider-Man" sobre el personaje de Venom, creado a principios de la década de 1980 por David Michelinie y Todd McFarlane para Marvel Comics.Este inicio de un nuevo Universo propio de Sony Pictures -a partir de los personajes más conocidos del Hombre Araña- está dirigido por Ruben Fleischer ("Gangster Squad. Brigada de élite", "Bienvenidos a Zombieland") y protagonizado por Tom Hardy, Michelle Williams, Riz Ahmed y Woody Harrelson.En la película, el periodista Eddie Brock, tras descubrir que Carlton Drake está realizando experimentos ilegales en humanos con formas de vida extraterrestres (los llamados simbiontes), decide realizar una visita clandestina a la Fundación Vida, en donde es infectado por una de esas criaturas.

programme.title: Watchmen
programme.desc: Zack Snyder dirige esta magistral adaptación de la mítica novela gráfica creada por el escritor Alan Moore, el dibujante Dave Gibbons y el colorista John Higgins para DC Comics. Considerada hasta ese momento como una obra imposible de trasladar al lenguaje cinematográfico (de hecho, el director Terry Gilliam abandonó su proyecto de llevarla a la gran pantalla), "Watchmen" es una novela gráfica de superhéroes, profunda y compleja, creada para un público adulto y primera en su género en ganar el prestigioso premio Hugo.Respetando la oscuridad del cómic del que bebe, la película "Watchmen" une lo mejor del original con la personal estética de Snyder, componiendo una obra muy alejada de la eterna lucha entre el bien y el mal de los tradicionales superhéroes de Hollywood. "Watchmen" está ambientada en 1985, en unos Estados Unidos alternativos inmersos en la Guerra Fría y en los que los superhéroes, antes admirados, están ahora proscritos.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

He soon distinguishes himself through his courageous service, but later becomes infected with malaria. He is sent home and treated with morphine, to which he soon becomes addicted. As he descends further into the throes of his deadly habit, his courageous wife, Cathy (Dianne Foster), vows to help her husband kick his addiction before it kills him.

programme.title: One Thrilling Night
programme.desc: Honeymooners (John Beal, Wanda McKay) find gangsters searching for money in their New York hotel room.

programme.title: The Ghost of Sierra de Cobre
programme.desc: Vivia Mandore, an heiress, enlists the services of a paranormal investigator to look into a suspected case of haunting involving the spirit of her deceased mother-in-law.

programme.title: Voodoo Island
programme.desc: A writer famous for exposing hoaxes investigates a tropical island supposedly rife with voodoo horrors.

programme.title: The Wild Party
programme.desc: Embittered ex-NFL pro Tom Kupfen (Anthony Quinn) has taken to hanging with a group of go-nowhere beatniks, including good-schoolgirl-gone-bad Honey (Kathryn Grant), hopped-up jazz musician Kicks Johnson (Nehemiah Persoff) and ticking time bomb Gage Freeposter (Jay Robinson). Together they drink, dabble in drugs and commit just enough petty thefts to support their lurid lifestyle. But when a con they try to pull on a couple of squares goes sour, the hip crooks get in way over their heads.

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: Davey Gordon (Jamie Smith), a New York City boxer aging out of his profession, meets dancer Gloria Price (Irene Kane), and they begin a romance. However, their budding relationship is interrupted by Gloria's violent boss, Vincent Rapallo (Frank Silvera), who has eyes for his employee. The two decide to skip town, but before they can, Vincent and his thugs abduct Gloria, and Davey is forced to search for her among the most squalid corners of the city, with his enemy hiding in the shadows.

programme.title: 99 River Street
programme.desc: Cab driver and ex-boxer Ernie (John Payne) discovers his wife Pauline (Peggie Castle) has been cheating on him. Ernie is approached by actress friend Linda (Evelyn Keyes), who says that she needs his help because she killed a man during an audition. After rushing to the theater, Ernie discovers that Linda's desperate tale was the audition. As if that humiliation isn't enough, Ernie is then framed for Pauline's murder by her lover, jewel thief Victor Rawlins (Brad Dexter).

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: Stan Grayson (Kevin McCarthy) dreams that he stabs an unknown man to death, but when he awakens, he is disturbed to find that he has bruises that he doesn't remember getting and a key in his room that doesn't belong to him. Confused, Stan explains his situation to his police officer brother-in-law, Rene (Edward G. Robinson), who initially believes that Stan is simply suffering from anxiety. As the evidence continues to mount, however, it seems to point to something more sinister.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: An old junk dealer's (Hugo Haas) chorus-girl bride (Cleo Moore) and helper (Vince Edwards) run into his twin brother.

programme.title: A Kiss Before Dying
programme.desc: Amoral Bud Corliss (Robert Wagner) pursues young heiress Dorie Kingship (Joanne Woodward) in the hopes of getting his hands on the fortune amassed by her father (George Macready). But after Dorie succumbs to Bud's charms and becomes pregnant as a result, he fears she'll be cut off by the family and murders her in a fashion that makes it look as if the poor girl committed suicide. When Bud tries to cozy up with Dorie's grieving sister, Ellen (Virginia Leith), she begins to suspect his intentions.

programme.title: The File of the Golden Goose
programme.desc: A U.S. agent (Yul Brynner) and a Scotland Yard man (Edward Woodward) infiltrate a forgery ring run by someone called the Owl.

programme.title: Danger Route
programme.desc: A British spy (Richard Johnson) is ordered to kill a Soviet scientist who has defected to the West.

programme.title: Sugar Hill
programme.desc: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancee, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers.

programme.title: The First Power
programme.desc: A Los Angeles policeman (Lou Diamond Phillips) hunts a killer (Jeff Kober) brought back from the gas chamber by Satan.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail.

programme.title: Scream Blacula Scream
programme.desc: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Hurricane Streets
programme.desc: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. Brendan Sexton III delivers a powerful performance in the central role of Marcus, a street-smart teen who dreams of the day that he can escape the city trap and live with his mother in the wide open spaces of New Mexico.

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Richard "Cochise" Morris (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs), a local basketball hero, and Leroy "Preach" Jackson (Glynn Turman), who dreams of a career in writing, are likable Chicago high school students in 1960s Chicago. They're into hanging out with friends, pretty girls and the Motown sounds so popular during the era. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry.

programme.title: Case 39
programme.desc: In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters.

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when then they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life in an idyllic and remote lakeside farmhouse. Still traumatized, their physical and mental well-being are pushed to the limit as their fragile existence is threatened.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: The Best of Me
programme.desc: Amanda and Dawson, who were once high-school sweethearts, have a bittersweet reunion when they return to their hometown for the funeral of a mutual friend. Seeing each other again after 20 years apart reignites the love they've never forgotten, but Amanda and Dawson soon discover that the forces that drove them apart when they were younger pose even more threats today.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life.

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure.

programme.title: Our Friend
programme.desc: After Nicole and Matthew receive life-altering news, the couple find unexpected support from their friend Dane, who puts his own life on hold to move into their family home.

programme.title: Camp X-Ray
programme.desc: A female guard at Guantánamo Bay forms an unlikely friendship with one of the facility's longtime detainees.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: Bang Bang
programme.desc: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past.

programme.title: Undisputed III: Redemption
programme.desc: Uri Boyka is an inmate trapped in the toughest prison in the world. He is ready to make his comeback in a lethal boxing competition for a shot at freedom.

programme.title: The Honey Trap: A True Story of Love, Lies and the FBI
programme.desc: The story of Denis Cuspert, aka Deso Dogg, and his journey from infamous German rapper to ISIS recruiter; exploring the circular relationship between propaganda, recruitment and the soft power of entertainment culture.

programme.title: The Core
programme.desc: Geophysicist Dr. Josh Keyes discovers that an unknown force has caused the Earth's inner core to stop rotating. With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core.

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in 1860's New York.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack; all evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody; Reacher, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney.. However, the more Reacher delves into the case, the less clear-cut it appears.

programme.title: Queen Bees
programme.desc: While her house undergoes repairs, fiercely independent senior Helen temporarily moves into a nearby retirement community, where she encounters lusty widows, cutthroat bridge tournaments and a hotbed of bullying "mean girls."

programme.title: The Prize Winner of Defiance, Ohio
programme.desc: Evelyn Ryan (Julianne Moore) suffers in her marriage to Kelly (Woody Harrelson), a slovenly alcoholic whose only consistent quality is his utter lack of respect for her. As Evelyn struggles to make ends meet and care for their 10 children, she begins to turn to contests as a source of entertainment and much-needed income. To the amazement of her friends and family, Evelyn's quick wit leads her to pen prizewinning amateur jingles and one-liners for products all across the spectrum.

programme.title: The Space Between Us
programme.desc: Gardner Elliot, the first human born on Mars, begins an online friendship with Tulsa, a teen in Colorado. On his maiden voyage to Earth, the 16-year-old finally gets to experience all the joys and wonders of a world he could only read about. Problems arise when scientists discover that Gardner's organs can't withstand the atmosphere. United with Tulsa and on the run, the interplanetary visitor races against time to unravel the mysteries of how he came to be, and where he belongs in the universe.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy.

programme.title: Winter Spring Summer or Fall
programme.desc: Young Remi has her future figured out, until she meets Barnes, who lives for the moment and makes her question everything. As their love story unfolds, she faces a choice -- stick to her plan or risk it all for a life she never saw coming.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: To the students at Harrington High, the principal and her posse of teachers have always been a little odd, but lately they've been behaving positively alien. Controlled by otherworldly parasites, the faculty try to infect students one by one. Cheerleader Delilah (Jordana Brewster), football player Stan (Shawn Hatosy), drug dealer Zeke (Josh Hartnett) and new girl Marybeth (Laura Harris) team up with some of their other classmates to fight back against the invaders.

programme.title: Into the Wild
programme.desc: A top student and athlete leaves his middle-class life to venture into Alaska, only to meet people who will eventually shape his values and life.

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights.

programme.title: Winter Spring Summer or Fall
programme.desc: Young Remi has her future figured out, until she meets Barnes, who lives for the moment and makes her question everything. As their love story unfolds, she faces a choice -- stick to her plan or risk it all for a life she never saw coming.

programme.title: The United States of Leland
programme.desc: A withdrawn young man, Leland Fitzgerald (Ryan Gosling) is imprisoned for the murder of a mentally disabled boy, who also happened to be the brother of his girlfriend, Becky (Jena Malone). As the community struggles to deal with the killing, Pearl Madison (Don Cheadle), a teacher at the prison, decides to write about Leland's case. Meanwhile, others affected by the murder, including Becky and her sister, Julie (Michelle Williams), must contend with their own problems.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status.

programme.title: Don't Knock Twice
programme.desc: A mother looking to reconnect with her estranged daughter attracts the attention of a demonic witch.

programme.title: Changeland
programme.desc: A man meets up with his best friend in Thailand while going through a personal crisis.

programme.title: The Weather Man
programme.desc: David Spritz (Nicolas Cage) is a Chicago weatherman who, despite success at his job, is deeply unhappy. Eclipsed by his father, Robert (Michael Caine), a celebrated author, and licking his wounds after his marriage to Noreen (Hope Davis) collapses, David resolves to get his life in order by applying for a high-profile job on a New York City talk show. But with his personal life a shambles, David must decide between fast-tracking his career and repairing his rapidly deteriorating family life.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: View From the Top
programme.desc: A comedy about a young woman from meager beginnings, who has high hopes for the future. Donna (Gwyneth Paltrow) dreams of becoming a first-class international flight attendant and is willing to do whatever it takes to ensure that her dreams come true. The road to success, though, is rarely a smooth flight, and as she begins her trip she encounters more turbulence than even she bargained for.

programme.title: Muriel's Wedding
programme.desc: Socially awkward Muriel Heslop (Toni Collette) wants nothing more than to get married. Unfortunately, due to her oppressive politician father (Bill Hunter), Muriel has never even been on a date. Ostracized by her more socially adept friends, Muriel runs into fellow outcast Rhonda Epinstalk (Rachel Griffiths), and the two move from their small Australian town to the big city of Sydney, where Muriel changes her name and begins the arduous task of redesigning her life to match her fantasies.

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna.

programme.title: The Beldham
programme.desc: A struggling new mother fights a generations-old presence lurking within her family's home, threatening her safety, her sanity, and the life of her infant child.

programme.title: Cursed
programme.desc: In Los Angeles, siblings Ellie (Christina Ricci) and Jimmy (Jesse Eisenberg) come across an accident on Mulholland Drive. As they try to help the woman caught in the wreckage, a ferocious creature attacks them, devouring the woman and scratching the terrified siblings. They slowly discover that the creature was a werewolf and that they have fallen victim to a deadly curse. Now that they have been sliced by the werewolf's claws, they will be transformed into werewolves themselves.

programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Tom Cruise stars as a struggling sports agent who falls for single mum Renee Zellweger. Top romantic comedy with Cuba Gooding Jr. Language.

programme.desc: Oscar-winning Mikey Madison stars as a sex worker who impulsively marries an oligarch's son, whose family try to get the marriage annulled.

programme.title: The Room Next Door
programme.desc: Ingrid and Martha became close friends while working together at the same magazine. Years later, they meet again in a strangely sweet situation.

programme.title: Poison
programme.desc: Dive into the love story of a couple who reunited many years after a tragedy drove them apart. Tim Roth and Trine Dyrholm star.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Hotshot television anchorman Ron Burgundy welcomes upstart reporter Veronica Corningstone into the male-dominated world of 1970s broadcast news -- that is, until the talented female journalist begins to outshine Burgundy on air. Soon he grows jealous, begins a bitter feud with Veronica and eventually makes a vulgar slip on live TV that ruins his career. However, when an outrageous story breaks at the San Diego Zoo, Ron may get a chance to redeem himself.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Seven years after capturing the heart of co-anchor Veronica Corningstone (Christina Applegate), newsman Ron Burgundy (Will Ferrell) is offered the chance of a lifetime: a spot on the world's first 24-hour global cable news network. Ron quickly assembles his team: Champ Kind (David Koechner), Brian Fantana (Paul Rudd) and Brick Tamland (Steve Carell). Challenged by his tough female boss, a network owner and a popular anchor, Ron and his pals must find their own way to the top of the ratings.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell) is a kindhearted radio executive who wants to be the best possible stepfather to his wife's (Linda Cardellini) two children. When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family.

programme.title: Daddy's Home 2
programme.desc: Father and stepfather Dusty and Brad join forces to make Christmastime perfect for the children. Their newfound partnership soon gets put to the test when Dusty's old-school, macho dad and Brad's gentle father arrive to turn the holiday upside down. After a sudden change in plans, the four men decide to take the kids to a luxury resort for a fun-filled getaway that turns into a hilariously chaotic adventure.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. They hope to take in one small child, but when they meet three siblings, including a rebellious 15-year-old girl, they find themselves speeding from zero to three kids overnight. Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: After a heist in Venice, Steve turns on his partners in crime, killing safecracker John Bridger and keeping all the gold for himself; the rest of the team, including leader Charlie Croker, driver Handsome Rob, explosives man Left Ear and tech geek Lyle, vows revenge; they enlist the help of Bridger's daughter, Stella and plot to recover the gold from Steve's Los Angeles mansion.

programme.title: The Knife
programme.desc: A family's life gets thrown into disarray when they find a mysterious woman in their new home. By the time the police arrive, the intruder is lying unconscious on the floor with a knife in her hand. Questioned by a detective, the couple and their two children try to safeguard one another's secrets. However, the choices they make soon lead to consequences even more graver than they could have imagined.

programme.title: Lowriders
programme.desc: A teenage graffiti artist (Gabriel Chavarria) paints murals on the hoods of lowrider cars to help his older brother (Theo Rossi) win an upcoming competition.

programme.title: Joy
programme.desc: A story of a family across four generations, centered on the girl who becomes the woman (Jennifer Lawrence) who founds a business dynasty and becomes a matriarch in her own right. Facing betrayal, treachery, the loss of innocence and the scars of love, Joy becomes a true boss of family and enterprise. Allies become adversaries and adversaries become allies, both inside and outside the family, as Joy's inner life and fierce imagination carry her through the storm she faces.

programme.title: Catching Dust
programme.desc: Geena finally decides to leave her criminal husband Clyde and their isolated Texas hideout, but a couple from New York suddenly arrives. Ignoring the risks, she convinces Clyde to let them stay, a decision with dangerous consequences.

programme.title: The Knife
programme.desc: A family's life gets thrown into disarray when they find a mysterious woman in their new home. By the time the police arrive, the intruder is lying unconscious on the floor with a knife in her hand. Questioned by a detective, the couple and their two children try to safeguard one another's secrets. However, the choices they make soon lead to consequences even more graver than they could have imagined.

programme.title: The Vow
programme.desc: Paige and Leo are happily married newlyweds, but their idyllic life together suddenly shatters when a car accident leaves her in a coma. When Paige awakes, she has severe memory loss and doesn't know Leo. She also has a confusing relationship with her parents and still harbors feelings for a former fiance. Despite these difficult obstacles, Leo is determined to renew their bond and rebuild their marriage.

programme.title: H Is for Happiness
programme.desc: An optimistic 12-year-old girl hatches scheme after scheme to make her mother, father and uncle happy again.

programme.title: Demoted
programme.desc: Two prankster tire salesmen are forced to become secretaries after their long-suffering boss finally gets tired of their antics.

programme.title: A Low Down Dirty Shame
programme.desc: After hitting a wall in his case against drug kingpin Ernesto Mendoza (Andrew Divoff), private eye Andre Shame (Keenen Ivory Wayans) quits the police department in disgrace. The wisecracking investigator thinks he's left his old life behind him, but now everything changes when an old chum from the force informs him of a break in the case. With the help of his motor-mouthed secretary, Peaches (Jada Pinkett), Andre leaps back into the action to solve the case and clear his name.

programme.title: Marci X
programme.desc: When protest breaks out over Dr. S's new CD, the owner of the rapper's record label, Ben Feld, is hospitalized by a heart attack. But his pampered daughter Marci, who's never set foot in the business world, steps in, stands up to Dr. S, and tries to tone down his bad-boy edge.

programme.title: Ingenious
programme.desc: A small-time inventor (Dallas Roberts) and a shady salesman (Jeremy Renner) hit rock-bottom before coming up with a novelty item that turns into a worldwide sensation.

programme.title: My Blueberry Nights
programme.desc: After her boyfriend of five years breaks up with her, Elizabeth (Norah Jones) consoles herself by consuming creamy confections at a sympathetic café owner's (Jude Law) eatery. She sets out on a road trip, supporting herself as a waitress along the way. Elizabeth meets a host of interesting characters on her journey, including an alcoholic policeman (David Strathairn), his unfaithful wife (Rachel Weisz), and a gambler (Natalie Portman).

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. A fancy competing gym called Globo-Gym, run by the maniacal health nut White Goodman (Ben Stiller), is about to put Average Joe's out of business unless Peter can raise $50,000 to keep his mortgage. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition.

programme.title: The Curse of Downers Grove

programme.title: Outlander

A relentless foreign mafia, seeking to settle scores, hunts them down, while unresolved family tensions from their past threaten to unravel their plans. Meanwhile, a determined police force is closing in, intent on bringing them to justice, turning their ambitious job into a race against time.

Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

"The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." programme.title: Des jours meilleurs
programme.desc: A la suite d'un accident de voiture, Suzanne, une veuve quinquagénaire, perd la garde de ses trois fils. Elle n'a plus le choix et doit se soigner dans un centre pour alcooliques. A peine arrivée, elle fait la connaissance d'Alice et Diane, deux femmes au caractère bien trempé. Denis, un éducateur sportif, va tenter de les réunir autour du même objectif : participer au rallye des Dunes dans le désert marocain. Il devra s'armer de beaucoup de patience et de pédagogie pour préparer cet improbable équipage à atteindre son objectif..

programme.title: Le cercle
programme.desc:
"Le Cercle" est un magazine de débats et de critiques cinéphiles animé par un journaliste en compagnie de chroniqueurs et en présence d'un public d'étudiants en cinéma
"Le Cercle" est un magazine de débats et de critiques cinéphiles animé par un journaliste en compagnie de chroniqueurs et en présence d'un public d'étudiants en cinéma.

programme.title: Lire Lolita à Téhéran
programme.desc: Azar Nafisi, professeur à l'université de Téhéran, a été contrainte de quitter son poste car elle a refusé de porter le voile. C'est alors qu'elle réunit secrètement sept de ses étudiantes pour lire des classiques de la littérature occidentale interdits par le régime. Dans un pays contrôlé par les fondamentalistes, ces séances leur permettent de retirer leur voile et de discuter de leurs espoirs, de leurs amours et de leur place dans une société de plus en plus oppressive. Pour ces femmes qui rêvent de liberté et d'émancipation, lire à Téhéran le "Lolita" de Vladimir Nabokov est une façon de célébrer le pouvoir émancipateur de la littérature.

programme.title: Mexico 86
programme.desc: Au milieu des années 1980, au Mexique. Maria, une militante révolutionnaire guatémaltèque, est depuis des années exilée à Mexico où elle poursuit sans relâche son action politique contre la junte militaire qui a pris le pouvoir dans son pays. Alors que son fils âgé de 10 ans vient vivre avec elle, la jeune femme saisit immédiatement qu'elle se trouve face à un dilemme cornélien. En effet, elle va devoir faire un choix entre son rôle de mère et celui d'activiste.

programme.title: Downton Abbey III : Le grand final
programme.desc: A l'aube des années 1930, la famille Crawley est encore grandement affectée par le décès de Lady Violet. Lady Mary, devenue l'une des figures importantes des salons mondains londoniens, se retrouve au coeur d'un scandale à la suite de son divorce. Confrontée à des difficultés financières, la famille doit également faire face au retour inattendu de Harold Levinson, le frère aîné de Cora, venu évoquer l'héritage de leur mère Martha. Alors que chacun tente de faire évoluer Downton Abbey avec son temps, une nouvelle ère pleine de défis, de remises en question et d'espoirs s'annonce pour la famille Crawley et son personnel..

programme.title: Fackham Hall
programme.desc: Angleterre, dans les années 1930. Rose Davenport rencontre Eric, un jeune pickpocket engagé par erreur au sein du manoir familial de Fackham Hall. Ils tombent aussitôt amoureux. Les parents de Rose, inquiets pour la succession de leur domaine, la poussent dans les bras d'Archibald, son cousin. Les choses se compliquent un peu plus lorsqu'un membre de la famille est mystérieusement assassiné.

programme.title: Les chevaliers du zodiaque : la légende du sanctuaire
programme.desc: Athéna, déesse de la paix mais aussi de la guerre, garantit l'équilibre sur Terre. Cible des forces du mal, elle est constamment protégée par les douze chevaliers du zodiaque. Son véhicule est un jour attaqué par un chevalier démoniaque. Ses gardiens vont tout faire pour la protéger. Les Chevaliers s'aventurent dans le Sanctuaire du Grand Pope, leader fou qui veut mettre la main sur le monde. Afin de le mettre hors d'état de nuire, ils affrontent les douze chevaliers d'or. La bataille est sans merci..

programme.title: Karate Kid 2
programme.desc: Le jeune Daniel est devenu l'un des karatékas les plus doués de Californie grâce à son vieux maître japonais, Miyagi. Un télégramme d'Okinawa informe le mentor que son père est mourant et l'appelle à son chevet. Miyagi hésite à retourner dans son pays et explique à Daniel qu'il veut à tout prix éviter d'y affronter son meilleur ami, Sato. Tous deux étaient jadis amoureux de la même jeune fille, Yukie, et Miyagi avait choisi de s'effacer. Ce grave manquement au code de l'honneur nécessite réparation, même si quarante ans se sont écoulés depuis. Daniel décide de suivre son maître à Okinawa. A peine arrivés, ils se heurtent à Sato, devenu un potentat local, et à son neveu..

programme.title: Johnny English, le retour
programme.desc: Cela fait des années que Johnny English, le plus surprenant et le plus maladroit des agents secrets britanniques, a pris sa retraite. Il vit désormais reclus dans un monastère d'Asie, où il s'est familiarisé avec des techniques martiales uniques. Un jour, le MI-7 fait appel à lui pour protéger le Premier ministre chinois d'un complot international qui le menace. Pour éviter que le monde ne sombre dans le chaos, Johnny English reprend du service, équipé des derniers gadgets à la mode. L'affaire est des plus délicates : les Russes et la CIA sont impliqués dans l'affaire, et même des agents du MI7..

programme.title: Breeders
programme.desc:
La famille Worsley accuse le coup donné par Luke à son père Paul. Ce dernier a déménagé et vit chez sa belle-mère Leah. Loin de souffrir de la solitude, il goûte aux bons côtés d'une vie plus simple. Il doit cependant trouver comment se réconcilier avec son fils. De son côté, Ally a son lot de problèmes, entre son travail, sa ménopause précoce et des relations de plus en plus compliquées avec sa fille Ava
Après l'altercation au cours de laquelle son fils Luke l'a frappé, Paul vit chez Leah, la mère d'Ally partie en lune de miel. Il observe le quotidien de sa famille par l'intermédiaire des caméras de sécurité et constate amèrement que ses enfants ne se portent pas plus mal sans lui. Jackie et Jim, ses parents, trouvent la situation étrange. Ava réclame le retour de son père, qui lui manque beaucoup. Paul se remémore un voyage lorsque Luke était plus jeune. En Streaming.

programme.title: Breeders
programme.desc:
La famille Worsley accuse le coup donné par Luke à son père Paul. Ce dernier a déménagé et vit chez sa belle-mère Leah. Loin de souffrir de la solitude, il goûte aux bons côtés d'une vie plus simple. Il doit cependant trouver comment se réconcilier avec son fils. De son côté, Ally a son lot de problèmes, entre son travail, sa ménopause précoce et des relations de plus en plus compliquées avec sa fille Ava
Pour Ally, la journée débute sur les chapeaux de roues : faire en sorte que les enfants soient prêts à temps pour l'école n'est pas une mince affaire. De plus, Darren lui apprend que son poste pourrait être compromis. De son côté, Paul apprécie de commencer la journée calmement et décide de partir travailler plus tard. Il déjeune avec Gabby puis se rend au cinéma. Tandis que Luke prétexte une crise de panique pour ne pas aller en cours, le mal-être d'Ava passe inaperçu. En Streaming.

programme.title: Ace Ventura en Afrique
programme.desc: Détective spécialisé dans la recherche et le sauvetage des animaux, Ace Ventura sillonne l'Himalaya, à la recherche d'un raton-laveur kidnappé. Malheureusement, ses efforts pour sauver l'animal sont vains et le petit animal est victime d'une chute mortelle. Accablé par cet échec, le détective se retire dans une lamaserie tibétaine pour y méditer longuement. C'est alors qu'arrive l'émissaire d'un ambassadeur américain en Afrique, qui lui demande de retrouver la mythique Shikaka, une chauve-souris sacrée qui a mystérieusement disparu. Cette disparition pourrait être à l'origine d'un grave conflit entre la tribu des Wachati et celle des Wachatootoo..

programme.title: Johnny English contre-attaque
programme.desc: Les agents britanniques sous couverture sont en danger à cause d'une cyberattaque. Johnny English, désormais retraité et qui enseigne, à sa façon, le métier d'espion, est alors chargé par le Premier ministre de sauver ses confrères. Le génie du piratage, responsable de l'attaque, est localisé sur la Côte d'Azur. Johnny English, dont les méthodes sont dépassées, découvre à ses risques et périls, les nouvelles technologies, comme la réalité virtuelle. En France, il rencontre la très belle et dangereuse Ophelia, proche du fameux pirate. Avec beaucoup de difficultés, Johnny English parvient à monter à bord du yacht du criminel..

programme.title: Les vedettes
programme.desc: Employé d'un magasin d'électroménager, Daniel semble loin de la carrière de chanteur dont il rêve depuis sa tendre enfance. A l'approche de la quarantaine, ce célibataire a désormais d'autres chats à fouetter, notamment régler ses trop nombreuses dettes. Impressionné par les connaissances de son collègue Stéphane, un homme aussi intelligent que naïf, il échafaude un plan. Ensemble, ils vont tenter d'écumer les plateaux de télévision en remportant les sommes mises en jeu. Enfin sélectionnés pour une émission, les deux s'y rendent avec l'espoir de gagner le gros lot. C'est finalement à cet instant que Daniel perce dans la chanson..

programme.title: Superlópez
programme.desc: El planeta Chitón está a punto de caer en manos de un malvado dirigente. La única esperanza de los habitantes de Chitón es el bebé Jo-Con-Él, que es enviado a la Tierra en un cohete que no termina, precisamente, en el lugar que sus padres tenían pensado.En esta adaptación del clásico del cómic español "Superlópez", Dani Rovira da vida al superhéroe del bigote, todo un icono de la cultura popular española creado en 1973 por el dibujante Jan (seudónimo de Juan López Fernández). Completan el reparto principal Alexandra Jiménez, Julián López y Maribel Verdú, que da vida a la villana Ágata Muller, la némesis que todo superhéroe necesita.Ganadora del Goya a los mejores efectos especiales, la película está dirigida por Javier Ruiz Caldera (que ya había dado vida a otro clásico del cómic español en "Anacleto: Agente secreto") y escrita por Borja Cobeaga y Diego San José, guionistas del taquillazo "Ocho apellidos vascos".

programme.title: Los tres mosqueteros

Juntos deberán enfrentarse al cardenal Richelieu, a la bella y astuta Milady De Winter y el infame conde de Rocheford, aliados en un complot para destronar al rey Luis XIII. Dirige esta versión de la obra de Alejandro Dumas "Los tres mosqueteros", Stephen Herek, responsable de "El hombre de la casa", "Siete días y una vida", "Rock Star", "El gurú, una incontrolable tentación" o "101 dálmatas (Más vivos que nunca)".

programme.desc: Un críptico mensaje, proveniente de su pasado, pone a James Bond tras la pista de una oscura organización. Mientras, en Londres, el nuevo jefe del Centro de Seguridad Nacional amenaza con acabar con el MI6. Tras "Skyfall" (2012) -anterior aparición de James Bond en la gran pantalla-, Sam Mendes vuelve a dirigir una película protagonizada por el famoso agente secreto inglés, creado por el escritor Ian Fleming en 1953. Vigesimocuarta película de la saga oficial -la producida por Eon- , "Spectre" está de nuevo protagonizada por Daniel Craig, que da vida, por cuarta vez, al agente 007. Junto a él, completan el reparto Christoph Waltz, Léa Seydoux, Ben Whishaw, Ralph Fiennes, Monica Bellucci, Naomie Harris y Dave Bautista. "Spectre" obtuvo el Oscar y el Globo de oro en 2016 a la mejor canción original, "Writing's On The Wall", de Sam Smith y James Napier.

programme.title: Wild India: Nilgiris
programme.desc: Durante más de dos mil quinientos millones de años, las fuerzas de la naturaleza han moldeado minuciosamente las Montañas Nilgiri hasta convertirlas en el lugar mágico que son hoy, ayudando a que se convirtieran en la primera Reserva de la Biosfera de la UNESCO en la India. Emprende un viaje para descubrir estas "montañas azules", una tierra que ha desafiado las nociones convencionales de lo que es la vida salvaje y que ha demostrado la extraordinaria capacidad de la naturaleza para adaptarse y prosperar en medio de la presencia humana. Aquí habita una historia de esperanza, fragilidad y futuros interconectados, donde humanos y fauna comparten los límites difusos de una naturaleza común.

programme.title: La costa de Croacia
programme.desc: La costa de Croacia.

programme.title: Katavi de vida
programme.desc: Un fenómeno climático extremo azota el remoto e inaccesible Parque Nacional Katavi en el sur de Tanzania. Las poderosas tribus locales de hipopótamos, leones y cocodrilos luchan por sobrevivir mientras defienden su territorio de los intrusos.

programme.title: Katavi: Santuario de vida
programme.desc: Un fenómeno climático extremo azota el remoto e inaccesible Parque Nacional Katavi en el sur de Tanzania. Las poderosas tribus locales de hipopótamos, leones y cocodrilos luchan por sobrevivir mientras defienden su territorio de los intrusos.

programme.title: David Attenborough: Océano
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough, colabora por primera vez con National Geographic en un documental que expone los mayores problemas a los que se enfrenta nuestros océanos. Pero ésta es una historia de esperanza, que pretende transmitir que ante nosotros tenemos una oportunidad para que la vida marina se recupere a una escala que nadie vivo ha visto jamás.

programme.title: Superviviente por naturaleza
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, educador, biólogo y aventurero indígena de tercera generación, está en una búsqueda para revelar algunas de las adaptaciones animales más extrañas y especializadas del planeta.

programme.title: Jaguar: icono de la jungla de Guyana
programme.desc: Un joven jaguar está a punto de embarcarse en la misión más importante de su vida: aventurarse a encontrar su propio reino. Su viaje le llevará a través de diversos hábitats, cada uno de ellos con su propia diversidad animal. Únicamente si es capaz de demostrar su valía podrá reclamar su trono en uno de los últimos paraísos realmente salvajes del planeta.

programme.title: Escuela de chimpancés
programme.desc: Los chimpancés de Sierra Leona pasan dificultades. Tras la guerra civil y el ébola, su supervivencia no es una prioridad, pero han empezado los intentos de recuperarlos y evitar que se extingan. El Santuario de Chimpancés Tacugama es un ejemplo. Para los chimpancés, la vida es simple: definir su personalidad, hacerse un hueco en un grupo, y buscar un modo de vida. Este documental es una historia íntima, cálida y desgarradora que nos muestra cómo viven y evolucionan distintos chimpancés que luchan por sobrevivir.

programme.title: El puma contra el lobo
programme.desc: Boone Smith es un experto en pumas que recorre el corazón de las montañas Bitterroot, en Montana, en busca de pruebas que ilustren la rivalidad que existe entre los dos depredadores más grandes que recorren esos parajes invernales. Su objetivo es localizar los lugares en los que ocurren la mayor parte de los enfrentamientos entre pumas y lobos, reuniendo pistas sobre sus hábitos de caza, su alimentación o su instinto de lucha.

programme.title: Jaguar: icono de la jungla de Guyana
programme.desc: Un joven jaguar está a punto de embarcarse en la misión más importante de su vida: aventurarse a encontrar su propio reino. Su viaje le llevará a través de diversos hábitats, cada uno de ellos con su propia diversidad animal. Únicamente si es capaz de demostrar su valía podrá reclamar su trono en uno de los últimos paraísos realmente salvajes del planeta.
